---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is this related to a problem?**
A clear description of the problem. E.g. "I can't do X when..."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should the feature do?

**Alternatives you've considered**
Any other approaches or workarounds you've tried?

**Use case**
Which game, workflow, or scenario would this help with?

**Additional context**
Mockups, links, references — anything that helps explain the idea.
